label: FiberMall GPON-ONU-STB+ GPON/EPON SFP ONT
description: Dual-mode 'PON on a Stick' ONU built into an SFP module with an integrated GPON/EPON MAC (chipset not published) that auto-negotiates a link with either a GPON or EPON OLT; GPON Class B+, 2.488 Gbit/s down / 1.244 Gbit/s up (T1310 nm / R1490 nm, APD-TIA receiver, SFF-8472 v9.5 DDM). SC/UPC connector (the SC/APC variant is the GPON-ONU-STAB+), no LAN ports and no Wi-Fi; host access over the SFP SerDes electrical interface (exact host line rate not published).
